column3: Interactive cards (approval, connect, secret) are kinds on the ask_user request path, owner-only with closed answers; secret values go only through secret.provide to the secret store; tool_search becomes one kernel extension held by ctx.pi.search(); the card tool rows ship disabled
column4: Mirrors questions instead of a second mechanism; a closed answer set is what keeps a typed secret or an agent approval out of the run; one shared tool_search is the only way two rows with deferred tools can both offer it (pi.install refuses a second owner); with a card row on, every request gains tool_search's 615 bytes and four src/cost.test.ts bounds fail (two-file edit 79049 > 78000, thread first request 6363 > 5760)
column5: plugins/secret-input/secret.test.ts, plugins/approval/approval.test.ts, plugins/connect/connect.test.ts, web/e2e/cards.test.ts; cost.test.ts green with the rows off
